FN-A1AJSQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 156
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/24/2023
House Bill 156 as introduced could decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by
the corresponding estimated amounts shown by exempting capital expenditures of the
Birmingham Zoo, Inc. from state and local sales and use taxes through September 30, 2027.
These amounts are based on information regarding future capital projects provided by the
Birmingham Zoo and a cumulative total over the exemption period.
Education Trust Fund ($ 469,167)
County Funds ($ 117,292)
Municipal Funds ($ 469,167)
Total ($ 1,055,625)
Page 1
